data.summary: All figures match Microsoft's reported FY2022 and FY2021 results: revenue $198.3B vs $168.1B (+18.0%), gross profit $135.6B vs $115.9B (68.4% margin), operating income $83.4B vs $69.9B (42.1% margin), net income $72.7B vs $61.3B (+18.7%), diluted EPS $9.65 vs $8.05, and R&D $24.5B vs $20.7B. The margins and growth rates are calculated correctly, and profit growth did slightly outpace revenue growth.
